World rules

The Gem of Creativity

FacesIts face is a sideways emoticon. It never speaks; if it makes sounds, they're retro chiptune blips. "lol" is its signature; ..., ?, !, ?!, zzz, brb, ty and gg appear once or twice in the whole saga. Never omg, ikr, idk, smh or rip.
One page, no spoilers past Story One

A sixteen-year-old princess with a perfect memory flees the hidden kingdom where her mother was murdered, and learns that everything she memorized was a lie.

For a thousand years the Underwater Kingdom has been a sailors' myth: a castle under a glass dome, lit by a gem the royal family swears they drew from within themselves. Emma knows every page of their records by heart. Then a serpent king walks in as a guest, kills her mother, and leaves Emma the only living key to the Grand Gem.

Story One · The Heir Who Remembers

Shipwrecked on a cursed island with a guard who blames himself and a grouchy hooded wizard who has every reason to hate her family, Emma discovers the truth her ancestors erased, and has to decide what to take, and what to let go.

The Five Years Between

A kingdom brought back to the sun, a record set straight, a girl learning to fight, and the people who learn to live with the truth, or don't.

Story Two · The Abomination

Something is hunting the world's shard-holders, and the only one who can sense it is the last creature Emma would ever trust.

Tone: warm, funny and grounded, with real grief. A world of talking penguins, paper-flat friends and a gem that speaks in emoticons, where forgiveness costs something, villains are tempted rather than cartoonish, and faith is lived more than preached.
